purpose: FTMO 2-Step challenge executor. BALANCED SAFEST BOOK: XAU champion + BTC + NDX + BRENT, equal 1/4 (long-only champion recipe, portfolio vol-target) at the 9% vol dial. BRENT (least-correlated sleeve, corr +0.05 to XAU) is added purely to trim drawdown: it lifts pass and cuts path DD -14.9%->-11.8% at ~zero speed cost. Same generic executor as the FundingPips basket (scripts/v5_basket_challenge_exec.py --config this).
_vol_note: 9% BALANCED operating point (chosen 2026-07-24). Frontier @9% (v5_ftmo_xau_diversifiers.py): XAU+BTC+NDX 96.3%/10.3mo/-14.9%; +BRENT (this book) 97.1%/10.5mo/-11.8%; XAU+NDX+BRENT only 87.2% (BTC's return is needed at higher vol). Override consumed by apply_model_to_guards (default MODELS ftmo vol=7%). Never RAISE vol mid-challenge; for the FUNDED stage drop back to 7% (XAU+NDX+BRENT, -7.7% DD).
_model_note: FTMO 2-Step (ftmo.com/en/trading-objectives, verified 2026-07-18): P1 +10% / P2 +5% target; 5% max daily loss (equity incl. floating, resets 00:00 CE(S)T); 10% max overall loss STATIC on initial; min 4 trading days; NO time limit; no 2-Step consistency rule; 1:100 leverage. This 4-asset book @9% sim: SR 1.67, ~97.1% pass, median ~10.5mo, path DD -11.8% (guard halts at 8%; the -11.8% is the 9-yr path, rarely realised inside a short challenge). Never raise vol mid-challenge.
_classes_note: The 100K-capable book. NOT sizeable below ~$100K (gold min-lot $4,020, BTC $640). For a $10K account use configs/v5_fp_flex_10k.json (SPX+ASX+ETH).
_buffer_note: no-trade band: skip a symbol whose target vs held leverage differs by < buffer x its own target (cuts churn).

symbols._note: engine symbol -> FTMO broker name (verified live on FTMO-Demo 2026-07-18). contract_size/price read live at execute time.

BTC._broker: FTMO FULL, contract 1.0 BTC/lot, vmin 0.01, spread ~$1 (1.5bp)

BRENT._broker: FTMO FULL, contract 100, vmin 0.01, min-lot ~$95, spread 7.58bp (verified live 2026-07-24)

guards._note: FTMO: daily limit 5% -> flatten at 3.5% from 00:00-CET anchor; max loss 10% -> halt at 8% from initial; targets +10% (P1) / +5% (P2). 1.5% buffer before each firm line.

_stop_loss_note: Prop-firm compliance only. Caps each symbol's worst case at 3% of account equity via a broker-side SL, recomputed every pass (vol-targeting changes position size continuously). Measured 2018-2026: sits 2.3-4.2x DAILY ATR away at the tightest historical position sizes and was NEVER hit by a single session in 8+ years (worst days BTC -38.6%, BRENT -31.5%, NDX -12.5%, XAU -11.6%). The book's real protection is the trend filter shrinking exposure; this stop is a backstop, not a strategy component. All tickets on a symbol get the SAME stop price derived from the volume-weighted average entry, so the AGGREGATE loss is capped.
